title: Too hard for kids to use
text: Too hard for kids to use. It’s alright. It doesn’t quite work as easily as it seems. You have to put so much pressure down to make the shape and seal it that kids can’t do it. Then it doesn’t go down far enough to easily tear off the excess bread.
